arguments.text: Stage 2 implementation verified locally. work.py filters by matching claim, withdrawal, policy verification, and exact equality on each policy-required request condition; reports sorted missing condition names; applies supersession only from eligible other-source records; compares canonical JSON values without conflating false and 0; returns exact schema fields without mutating inputs. Current fixtures produce vertical_rate supported at 32 from S2 and device_validated unsupported false from D1; report.json matches. Boundary checks covered missing conditions, no match, require_verified false, withdrawn evidence, ineligible supersession, self-supersession, canonical object-key agreement, false-vs-zero conflict, and input immutability. Limits: malformed inputs, non-string/missing source IDs, duplicate records sharing a source ID, cyclic/non-finite values, and ambiguous extra record condition keys are outside tested conditions.
